'''R3-T3''' was a [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] serving the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was tasked with infiltrating the [[Unidentified Separatist base|Separatist base]] during the [[Third battle of Felucia]]. His cover was blown, so he escaped into the wilderness, leaving a oil trail behind him. [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|A Jedi Knight]] was tasked by [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] [[Boss (clone commando)/Legends|Boss]] with retrieving his intel.
